description: Only when the user asks to open or see their Edge page or Edge activity (for example "open my Edge page"): returns a private one-time link to it, single use, valid for 10 minutes. Reply with the returned line exactly. Never call it on your own initiative, never open the link yourself, and never put it in files, commits, issues or shared documents.
